See also: Fire and Burning

It is one of the types of Magical Damage. It comes in many forms.
Fire Damage appears in the Game Window as Orange Text.

Fire Attacks

Spells and Runes

List of spells and runes which inflict Fire Damage.

Spells

Name Words Prem Level Vocations Mana Group Effect
Scorch exevo infir flam hur ✗ 1 Sorcerers 8 Attack Shoots a weak area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing fire damage.
Apprentice's Strike exori min flam ✗ 6 Sorcerers and Druids 6 Attack Shoots a weak fire missile at the selected target up to 3 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Flame Strike exori flam ✗ 8 Sorcerers and Druids 20 Attack Shoots a fire missile at the selected target up to 3 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Fire Wave exevo flam hur ✗ 18 Sorcerers 25 Attack Shoots an area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing fire damage.
Ignite utori flam ✓ 26 Sorcerers 30 Attack Deals Fire Damage over time, similar to Electrify.
Great Fire Wave exevo gran flam hur ✓ 38 Sorcerers 120 Attack Shoots an area attack directly in front of the caster, dealing fire damage.
Hell's Core exevo gran mas flam ✓ 60 Sorcerers 1100 Attack Causes a devastating explosion of flames, dealing extremely high fire damage on a total of 73 squares around the caster.
Strong Flame Strike exori gran flam ✓ 70 Sorcerer 60 Attack Shoots a powerful fire missile at the selected target up to 7 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.
Ultimate Flame Strike exori max flam ✓ 90 Sorcerers 100 Attack Shoots a very powerful fire missile at the selected target up to 7 square meters away. If no target is selected, the damage is focused on the single square right in front of the caster.

Note: With exception of the basic Flame Strike available for both Druids and Sorcerers, Instant Fire Attack spells are a specialty of Sorcerers.
